about: The Linux native suite's engine lanes (#171, docs/doperpowers/specs/2026-10-28-own-linux-engine-design.md, The facade suites; M1b), read by `node scripts/repl-parity.mjs run --suite native --host cua --engine cua` (the run's assessment, scripts/repl-parity/vendor-defects.mjs assessAssertions) and by `node scripts/repl-parity.mjs diff <vendor-engine run> <cua-engine run> --expected scripts/repl-parity/expected/native-linux.json` (scripts/repl-parity/native-linux.mjs). `candidateExpectations` are the cua engine's temporary outcomes, until `until`: the run accepts exactly the named case's assertion failure with exactly the named exercise result, and nothing else (M1b: the engine refuses type_text and clipboard_write with `type_text is not available in this engine build`, M1a's declared deviation, so the text stays unchanged and the window alive; M2 makes the cases positive and removes these). `baselineMethodCases` are the same deviation's outcomes in the native baseline's typeText and paste method cases, which `node scripts/native-baseline.mjs compare --engines` accepts on the cua lane (scripts/native-baseline/compare.mjs), also until M2. `declarations` are the differences the diff between the two lanes accepts, each naming the vendor engine's declared defect (test/repl-parity/vendor-defects.json) and the cua engine's candidate expectation it pairs on one case: only those cases' exercise results and assertions are projected, and only while both sides hold exactly what they name; a declaration nothing needed is itself a difference.

candidateExpectations.reason: M1a's declared deviation: until M2's verified paste route, cua-engine answers type_text with `type_text is not available in this engine build` instead of reproducing the vendor's known PasteText failure; nothing is sent, the marker does not reach the text and gedit stays alive (Decision Log, M1a; Plan of Work, M1b).

declarations.reason: Both engines fail typeText in M1b, differently: the pinned vendor engine tries EditableText.PasteText for 10 s and inserts nothing, cua's engine refuses before sending anything. Neither inserts the marker and gedit survives both.
